title: Hardware-Aware Functional Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Efficient Medical Image Enhancement and Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2609.36134v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Functional Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (FunKAN) achieve state-of-the-art accuracy on MRI Gibbs artifact removal and anatomical segmentation, but their 11.6 M parameters and 8.7 GFLOPs are too large for edge medical devices. We present FunKANLite, a two-stage, hardware-aware compression of FunKAN for point-of-care use. FunKANLite-TR reduces the spatial prior and replaces the ResBlock offset predictor with a depthwise-separable block. It has 1.9x fewer parameters than FunKAN and no loss in accuracy. We then distill FunKANLite-TR into FunKANLite-ST, which lowers the Hermite basis rank, factorizes the spatial prior into a low-rank form, and halves the filter widths. translated_title: 面向高效医学图像增强与分割的硬件感知函数型Kolmogorov-Arnold网络
translated_abstract: 函数型Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（FunKAN）在MRI吉布斯伪影去除和解剖结构分割方面达到了最先进的精度，但其11.6M参数量和8.7 GFLOPs的计算量对于边缘医疗设备而言过于庞大。我们提出了FunKANLite，这是一种面向床旁应用的两阶段硬件感知FunKAN压缩方法。第一阶段FunKANLite-TR降低了空间先验，并用深度可分离模块替代ResBlock偏移预测器，参数量比FunKAN减少1.9倍且精度无损失。随后我们将FunKANLite-TR蒸馏为FunKANLite-ST，该方法降低了Hermite基的秩，将空间先验分解为低秩形式，并将滤波器宽度减半。FunKANLite-ST的参数量比FunKAN减少5.6倍、计算量减少3.7倍，在BUSI、GlaS和CVC-ClinicDB数据集上IoU与FunKAN的差距保持在1.4个百分点以内，并在IXI数据集上达到33.95 dB的PSNR。在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano和Raspberry Pi 5上，FunKANLite-ST显著降低了单次推理的能量消耗（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出FunKANLite——一种面向边缘医疗设备的两阶段硬件感知压缩框架，通过结构轻量化与知识蒸馏将FunKAN的参数量降低5.6倍、计算量降低3.7倍，同时在医学图像增强与分割任务上保持接近原有的精度。
en_tdlr: Proposes FunKANLite, a two-stage hardware-aware compression framework for edge medical devices, which reduces FunKAN's parameters by 5.6x and GFLOPs by 3.7x through structural lightweighting and knowledge distillation while maintaining near-original accuracy on medical image enhancement and segmentation tasks.
